This wiki collects criteria for evaluating researchers in each topic of the
[https://openalex.org OpenAlex] classification. The classification has four levels:
'''domain → field → subfield → topic'''.

''Pilot: the pages below contain only the OpenAlex data so far. Criteria (venues, awards,
weights) will be added and reviewed by domain experts.''

== Domains ==
{{#cargo_query:tables=Domains
|fields=_pageName=Domain,works_share=Share of works (%),citations_share=Share of citations (%)
|order by=works_share DESC
|format=table
|default=''No domains stored yet.''
}}
